note: Hand-placed anchors for assets/sprites/*.png, in file pixels. Weapons: grip = top of the handle, 2 px under the body; fore = foregrip, pump, magazine or tank top (if any); muzzle = end of the bore; eject = ejection port (if any). bomblet.tail makes the warhead a mini rocket flown nose first, exhaust at the tail. parachute.cords: where the cords meet. jetpack: strap pivot on the back and the two nozzles.
